macros.name: customcode
macros.doc: \customcode accepts all the commands accepted by the picture environment. This snippet of code is inserted inside the picture environment used to draw the subsequent graph paper.

macros.name: loglog
macros.doc: The optional parameter in the \loglog command chooses wether the decade length along the abscissa and ordinate axes must have the same dimension.

macros.name: logpolar
macros.doc: The commadns \polar, \logpolar, \smith are used to plot polar, logpolar, and Smith chart graph papers.

macros.name: setgridcolor
macros.doc: \setgridcolor sets the color of the grid.

macros.name: setminimumdistance
macros.doc: \setminimumdistance specifies the minimal optical distance between two lines.

macros.name: setxside
macros.doc: \setxside and \setyside allow to specify the dimensions of the rectangle of the grid.

macros.name: setyside
macros.doc: \setxside and \setyside allow to specify the dimensions of the rectangle of the grid.
